title: ChainFL-RA: Blockchain-Enabled Decentralized Federated Learning with Reputation-Weighted Robust Aggregation and On-Chain Auditable Incentives
description:
Official implementation and experimental artifacts of ChainFL-RA, a blockchain-enabled decentralized federated learning framework that unifies robust aggregation, on-chain reputation, and token settlement under a single verifiable quality signal.

The same per-update evidence — cosine similarity to a momentum-anchored robust reference, guarded by a magnitude check — simultaneously determines (1) aggregation weights (reputation-weighted robust aggregation, RAgg), (2) on-chain reputation (slash-only memory with slow recovery), and (3) token settlement (smart-contract rewards and penalties). Every decision is committed to a hash-chained, validator-re-executable ledger. RAgg requires neither a clean validation set nor knowledge of the number of adversaries.

Evaluated against FedAvg, Krum, FedRoLA, and FLAME on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 under label-flipping, update-scaling, and an adaptive Min-Max attack at 10–30% malicious ratios, ChainFL-RA is the only method that remains robust in every setting. The repository contains the full source code, 693-job experiment pipeline, raw per-round CSV outputs, analysis scripts, and all paper figures.
